description: Lastage/Nieuwmarkt cornice houses (lijstgevels, 17th-18th c. fronts and their 19th-c. rebuilds; Rapenburg 95-97, 2024-12-10): 5.4-6 m fronts of dark brown brick over a white-painted ground storey of 4.2-4.8 m (door, wide window, door), three axes of tall white two-light sashes (2.1 m on the first storey, 2.0 on the second, 1.5 on the top), and a white plastered attic frieze with its cornice (12.5-14.7 m), or a small white dormer over a plain cornice

match.note: Rapenburg 97 (181605, strip 2024-12-10, gridded crop): white ground storey 0-4.3 m, windows 4.5-6.6 / 7.4-9.4 / 10.1-11.6 m, brick to 12.5 m, frieze and cornice to 14.7 m; 1905 is the BAG placeholder in the centre (unknownYears), and BAG dates many of these fronts 1810-1925 after rebuilds, so the skyline crown decides against the bell house (crownMatch); the top storey carries the frieze (12.5-14.7 m) so the eaves is the cornice top 14.7 m, not 3DBAG's 11.6; round 2 (Opus verdict): windows 4.5-6.6 / 7.1-9.2 / 10.1-11.6 m, white frieze and cornice 12.5-14.7 m (entablature 2.2 m); two-light sashes on storeys 1-2, cross window on top, flush full-frame surrounds

frieze.note: Rapenburg 97 (181605, Opus strip verdict 2026-11-10): a white frieze and cornice 2.2 m deep (entablature, 12.5-14.7 m on the strip) over the brick, no dormer

dormer.note: Rapenburg 95 (181532): a white dormer over the middle behind a plain cornice

groundFront.evidence: Rapenburg 97 strip 2024-12-10: white-painted ground storey, door left, wide window, door right

rhythm.groundFloor: a house door and windows, or a shop
rhythm.roofline: white frieze and cornice, or a cornice with one dormer
schemaLimits: the frieze has no oculi or console brackets
the ground storey shop glazing bars are not drawn
